title: MANIFEST
universal_lens: The manifest formalizes a high-dimensional state-transition system where raw empirical data (tracking, kinematics) is mapped to latent value spaces (EPA, WP, MPS). The structural unification lies in the operator $\mathcal{T}$ that transforms discrete event sequences into continuous probabilistic manifolds, bridging situational sports dynamics and biomechanical strain fields through shared differential geometries.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs Bayesian hierarchical inference over the verified item rows. Each lane represents a conditional prior distribution $P(Lane|Domain)$. Conformal prediction sets are constructed around the `TRAINING_VALUE` labels (e.g., ground-truth kinematics), ensuring that out-of-sample impact classifications maintain rigorous coverage guarantees despite non-stationary field conditions and sensor noise.
gse_mapping: GSE treats the master table as a Markov Decision Process (MDP). Situational reasoning maps play-by-play events to Expected Points Added (EPA) gradients. State transitions are governed by the `nflverse` pipelines, where instantaneous brain-strain models (WHIM) act as terminal reward functions for collision states, optimizing defensive alignments against maximum principal strain outcomes.

primitives.name: Instantaneous Brain-Strain Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: rk that instantly estimates element-wise whole-brain peak maximum principal strain (MPS) from head-impact kinematics; trained on finite-element simulations from the anisotropic Worcester Head Injury Model (WHIM v1 | TRAINING VALUE: Metric = element-wise peak MPS strain fields (labels generated by WHIM FE simulation over 2,592 augmented training impacts).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: $\varepsilon_{\text{MPS}}$: Peak Maximum Principal Strain (dimensionless), $\mathbf{x}$: Spatial coordinate vector (m), $\mathbf{n}$: Unit normal vector (dimensionless), $\nabla \mathbf{u}$: Displacement gradient tensor (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Linear elastic anisotropic material properties of brain tissue; small deformation theory applies locally before yielding; kinematics perfectly map to boundary conditions.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Fails under extreme hyperelastic large-deformation regimes where linear strain tensors diverge from Green-Lagrange strains; singularity occurs at fluid-tissue interface boundaries.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE collision-state valuation. The displacement gradient tensor mirrors the spatial derivative of player tracking coordinates during a tackle.
layer2.telemetry: Element-wise peak MPS strain fields validated against WHIM FE simulation ground truth.

primitives.name: Expected Points Gradient Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: polars-first | CFB/NFL pbp with EP/WP labels from its own models, plus team box scores and rosters.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: $\Delta \text{EPA}_t$: Change in Expected Points Added (points), $S_T$: Final score (points), $\mathcal{F}_t$: Filtration of game state up to time $t$ (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Markovian property of game states; optimal future play-calling probabilities remain stationary across seasons; no external shocks.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down at end-of-game clock management singularities where strategic utility decouples from pure point maximization.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSE state-transition kernels. The EPA gradient defines the local slope of the win-probability manifold used for real-time tactical inference.
layer2.telemetry: EP/WP labels derived from proprietary models applied to CFB/NFL play-by-play data.

primitives.verbatim_quote: Rows are merged here by the coordinator from per-wave INDEX fragments as waves land.

primitives.assumptions: Commutative merging of disjoint index fragments; atomic verification of upload status; no concurrent write conflicts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularity arises if wave definitions overlap in primary keys, causing non-invertible merge collisions or infinite recursion in dependency graphs.
